content.short: SpinUp is a Hyperliquid DeFi hub built around mHYPE liquid staking and a token launchpad.
content.description: SpinUp combines liquid staking, a meme launchpad and a DEX on Hyperliquid. Stakers deposit HYPE and receive mHYPE, usable across HyperEVM after bridging from Hyperliquid. The launchpad licenses standardised contract modules to projects so they can run a token launch and seed liquidity without writing their own, and the resulting tokens trade on the built-in meme DEX. Activity earns Drops that count toward SUP airdrop access, and the team is extending into HIP-3 markets.
content.meta: mHYPE liquid staking paired with a launchpad, covering both sides of a young chain.
